hebrewText: מִ/מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד מְבוֹא֑/וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה

tokens.bdb: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
tokens.kjv: [phrase] east side(-ward), sun (rising), [phrase] west(-ward), window. See also H1053 (בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ).

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

tokens.bdb: an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards
tokens.kjv: by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, [phrase] westward. Compare H4126 (מוֹבָא).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: an entrance ; specifically sunset or the west; also  towards
tokens.enLiteralWord: an entrance ; specifically sunset or the west; also  towards
tokens.explanation: an entrance ; specifically sunset or the west; also  towards
tokens.explanationEn: an entrance ; specifically sunset or the west; also  towards

tokens.bdb: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
tokens.kjv: (make) boast (self), celebrate, commend, (deal, make), fool(-ish, -ly), glory, give (light), be (make, feign self) mad (against), give in marriage, (sing, be worthy of) praise, rage, renowned, shine.

tokens.bdb: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"
